title: Waiting Hai
tagline: Tatkal ka master, system ka disaster.
synopsis: Centered on one of the world's most audacious and lucrative railway ticketing rackets, Waiting Hai follows Afroz Hamza, an ingenious computer software programmer who develops high-speed automated bots to illegally monopolize IRCTC Tatkal tickets, and Sugam Mishra, a determined, newly enlisted Railway Protection Force (RPF) cop obsessed with taking down the shadow syndicate.

episodes.title: Confirmed Ya RAC
episodes.synopsis: Afroz Hamza discovers a millisecond bypass flaw in the Indian Railways Tatkal ticket reservation pipeline, while newly posted RPF officer Sugam Mishra takes charge at a chaotic junction station.

episodes.title: Tatkal Ka Baap
episodes.synopsis: Afroz scales his illegal software to hundreds of ticketing touts across the northern railway belt. Meanwhile, Sugam identifies suspicious rapid counter bookings and begins digging into unusual booking logs.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.synopsis: As festival ticket rush approaches, Afroz's software books 50,000 confirmed berths in under 30 seconds. Sugam's cyber-team identifies automated bot signatures, triggering an intense pursuit.

episodes.title: Speed 100 Mbps
episodes.synopsis: Afroz sets up high-speed server nodes across multiple states to evade IP tracking. Sugam stages an undercover sting operation at a key transit hub in Kanpur.

episodes.title: Server Down
episodes.synopsis: Sugam and his team launch a synchronized dawn raid on cyber cafes, but Afroz activates a remote wipe killswitch just seconds before the servers are seized.

episodes.title: The Red Line
episodes.synopsis: Internal pressure mounts on Sugam from higher railway brass as the financial scale of the scam crosses hundreds of crores. Afroz plans his ultimate exit.

episodes.title: Waiting List Zero
episodes.synopsis: The explosive season finale: Afroz and Sugam come face-to-face in a high-voltage railway chase during the peak holiday departure rush with everything on the line.
